expected_solc_divergence.reason: Before '0.8.4' solc reported error 4224 on any code access to a deriving contract, without reachability analysis. Since '0.8.4' solc leaves getters out of its reachability analysis, so it never records the dependency and accepts this program, then fails with an internal error during code generation. Slang counts a public constant's getter as an entry point and reports the cycle on every version.
